summary: Frontend-only retest of borrower SHARE action sheet on /borrower/<id>. Login + navigation worked, intro overlay video had to be dismissed first. After dismissal the borrower page renders correctly and the SHARE pill (testID=share-borrower-btn) is present, but tapping it does NOT open the new in-app bottom-sheet Modal. None of the expected option testIDs (share-option-share / share-option-save / share-option-cancel) ever appear in the DOM, and the subtitle 'Share this contact or save it to your phone.' is never rendered. Also detected: a global IntroOverlay <video> with zIndex 9999 from /app/frontend/src/IntroOverlay.tsx covers the page on every fresh nav, swallowing all PillButton taps until the user clicks the video or 15s elapses — affects EDIT/SHARE/DELETE alike.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping SHARE pill does NOT open the new in-app Modal. Verified after dismissing intro overlay so clicks reach the button (DOM stack confirms share-borrower-btn is reachable). Real Playwright click() with force=True, page.mouse.click() at centre, JS .click(), and even direct React fiber memoizedProps.onPress() invocation all return 'invoked' / no error, yet showShareSheet never flips to true: no [data-testid='share-option-share' | 'share-option-save' | 'share-option-cancel'] is rendered and the subtitle text never appears. For comparison, invoking edit-borrower-btn's onPress via the same fiber walk DOES open the EDIT modal, so React state + Modal rendering work in general — handleShare specifically is failing to surface the sheet. Reference: /app/frontend/app/borrower/[id].tsx:139-141 (handleShare) and :322-363 (Modal). Suspect: stale closure, conditional rendering, or transparent slide Modal positioned offscreen on RN-Web.

Global IntroOverlay (expo-video VideoView wrapped in Pressable, zIndex 9999, position absolute) renders on top of every screen on a fresh load/nav and intercepts ALL clicks until the user clicks it or 15s passes. This affects every PillButton on /borrower/<id> (EDIT/SHARE/DELETE) and blocks Playwright tests entirely. Reference: /app/frontend/src/IntroOverlay.tsx:64-80.

action_items: Fix SHARE bottom-sheet not rendering: handleShare runs but the <Modal visible={showShareSheet} ...> never becomes visible. Verify showShareSheet state actually updates (add console.log in handleShare and useEffect on showShareSheet to confirm). If state IS updating, the slide-up Modal with transparent backdrop may be rendering offscreen on RN-Web — try animationType='fade' as a sanity check, or move the backdrop TouchableOpacity into a plain View wrapper. Compare structure to the working EDIT Modal in the same file (lines 261-318) — EDIT uses KeyboardAvoidingView, SHARE uses raw TouchableOpacity for the backdrop. The latter pattern (TouchableOpacity as backdrop wrapping the sheet View) is known to misbehave on RN-Web when activeOpacity=1.

Decide on IntroOverlay UX: the 15s/tap-to-skip intro currently blocks EVERY interaction on a fresh page load. Either gate it to only run once per session (shouldShowIntro already exists in src/idle), or set pointerEvents='box-none' on the wrapper after the video starts so the user can still tap the page underneath. Right now in the web preview it eats every click.
critical_code_review_comments: borrower/[id].tsx share sheet backdrop uses <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={1} onPress={close}> wrapping the sheet content — on RN-Web this can swallow taps on the inner options because the inner buttons are descendants of the same Touchable. Prefer a Pressable backdrop and a sibling View for the sheet, with stopPropagation on inner taps.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) On every fresh web nav an IntroOverlay <video> covers the screen for ~15s; tap centre of viewport (195, 422 on a 390x844 mobile viewport) to dismiss before testing buttons. 2) Login flow needs page.locator(testid).fill() (NOT keyboard.type) on auth-email; auth-password works either way. 3) Direct nav https://login-stretch-layout.preview.emergentagent.com/borrower/661642c1-8d89-4978-8fb4-6898369e1ff4 works once logged in. 4) After intro dismissed and SHARE clicked, no share-option-* testIDs ever appear — confirm by checking document.documentElement.innerHTML for 'Share this contact or save'. EDIT modal works under the same conditions, so the bug is specific to the share sheet rendering.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: 1) Login as MechanicLTZ@gmail.com/Blue321! 2) Navigate to /borrower/661642c1-8d89-4978-8fb4-6898369e1ff4 3) Dismiss intro overlay by clicking centre of viewport 4) Click [data-testid='share-borrower-btn'] (or invoke its onPress via React fiber.memoizedProps.onPress) 5) Wait 3s 6) Observe: document.querySelector('[data-testid="share-option-share"]') is null; body innerText does not contain 'Share this contact or save it to your phone'. Expected: bottom-sheet Modal slides up with contact name, subtitle, and three options. The handler handleShare in borrower/[id].tsx:139-141 only does setShowShareSheet(true); the JSX at :322-363 conditionally renders <Modal visible={showShareSheet}>. Either setShowShareSheet is not actually updating state (e.g., stale closure from a previous data load), or the Modal is mounting but its slide animation + transparent backdrop renders offscreen on RN-Web. EDIT modal in the same file uses the same setState pattern and DOES render, which points to either the TouchableOpacity-as-backdrop pattern or the absence of KeyboardAvoidingView as the differentiator. Mitigation: replace the share-sheet's outer TouchableOpacity backdrop with a plain View + an absolutely-positioned Pressable backdrop sibling, OR temporarily switch animationType from 'slide' to 'fade' to confirm whether the slide animation is the culprit on web.
